children: Centene delivered notice to redeem $568,664,000 of its 4.25% notes due December 15, 2027, with redemption set for October 23, 2026.
Notice of redemption issued for all remaining $568,664,000 aggregate principal of 4.25% notes due Dec. 15, 2027.
Redemption date is October 23, 2026, after which no 2027 notes will remain outstanding.
Redemption price: 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date.
This Form 8-K is informational and does not itself constitute the notice of redemption.
